meta.name: Monitor competitors daily with OpenAI, Notion, Google Sheets, Slack, and Gmail

parameters.content:
# AI Competitor Monitoring Platform

## What this workflow does

This workflow automatically monitors competitor websites and RSS feeds, summarizes the latest updates with AI, stores the results in Google Sheets and Notion, and sends notifications through Slack and Gmail. It helps marketing teams, product managers, founders, and SEO professionals stay informed about competitor activity without manual research.

## How it works

1. Loads workflow configuration.
2. Collects website content and RSS feeds.
3. Merges and removes duplicate updates.
4. Uses OpenAI to generate summaries.
5. Stores insights in Google Sheets and Notion.
6. Sends Slack and email notifications.

## Setup

☐ Connect OpenAI credentials

☐ Connect Google Sheets

☐ Connect Notion

☐ Connect Slack

☐ Connect Gmail

☐ Update the Workflow Configuration node with your competitors.

## Customization

• Add more competitors in the Configuration node.

• Replace Slack with Teams or Discord.

• Replace Google Sheets with Airtable or Supabase.

## Configuration

Update your competitors, RSS feeds, notification channels, and AI model before running the workflow.

## Website Monitoring

Downloads competitor webpages and extracts the latest content for analysis.

## RSS Monitoring

Fetches the latest articles from competitor RSS feeds and removes duplicate entries.

## AI Analysis

Sends the collected content to OpenAI to generate structured summaries and key insights.

## Storage

Stores the generated insights in Google Sheets and Notion for future reference.

## Notifications

Sends summarized competitor updates to Slack and Gmail.

⚠ Before running

Connect your OpenAI, Google Sheets, Notion, Slack, and Gmail credentials.

Update the Workflow Configuration node with your own competitors before enabling the schedule.

parameters.jsCode:
var articles = $json.articles || [];
var competitor = articles.length > 0 ? (articles[0].competitor || 'Unknown') : 'Unknown';
var reportDate = articles.length > 0 ? (articles[0].report_date || articles[0].published_at || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]) : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
var keywords = $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.keywords || '';
var model = $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.openai_model || 'gpt-4o';

var systemPrompt = 'You are an expert competitive intelligence analyst producing daily briefings for senior business leaders. Analyze the provided competitor data with precision and strategic insight. Focus on actionable intelligence that can influence product, marketing, and business development decisions. Your reports must be factual, prioritized by business impact, and formatted in clean Markdown. Always extract and highlight: (1) product launches and feature releases, (2) pricing or packaging changes, (3) marketing campaigns and brand positioning shifts, (4) hiring trends signaling strategic direction, (5) new partnerships or ecosystem moves, (6) funding and financial events, and (7) any indicators of strategic risk to competitors in this market.';

var articleSummaries = articles.slice(0, 20).map(function(a, i) {
  return (i + 1) + '. SOURCE: ' + (a.source || 'unknown') + '
   HEADLINE: ' + (a.headline || a.title || 'No headline') + '
   URL: ' + (a.url || 'N/A') + '
   CONTENT: ' + (a.content || a.summary || 'No content').substring(0, 400);
}).join('

');

var userMessage = 'COMPETITOR INTELLIGENCE ANALYSIS REQUEST

Competitor: ' + competitor + '
Report Date: ' + reportDate + '
Keywords to emphasize: ' + keywords + '
Total data points collected: ' + articles.length + '

DATA COLLECTED:

' + articleSummaries + '

Produce a comprehensive intelligence report in Markdown with EXACTLY these sections:

# Competitor Intelligence Report: ' + competitor + '

## Executive Summary
[2-3 sentence overview of the single most important developments detected today]

## Key Changes Detected

### Product & Feature Updates
[Bullet list of detected product launches, feature releases, roadmap signals — write None detected if nothing found]

### Pricing & Packaging
[Bullet list of pricing changes, new tiers, promotions, or discontinuations — write None detected if nothing found]

### Marketing & Brand Activity
[Bullet list of campaign signals, messaging shifts, new positioning — write None detected if nothing found]

### Hiring Trends
[Bullet list of hiring signals indicating strategic direction — write None detected if nothing found]

### Partnerships & Ecosystem
[Bullet list of new partnerships, integrations, or ecosystem moves — write None detected if nothing found]

### Funding & Financial Events
[Bullet list of funding rounds, acquisitions, earnings news — write None detected if nothing found]

## Urgency Score: [NUMBER]/10
[One sentence justification of the urgency rating — 1 is minimal activity, 10 is major competitive threat]

## Risk Level: [Low/Medium/High]
[One sentence explaining the strategic risk to your business from this competitor this period]

## Recommended Actions
1. [Specific action your team should take based on findings]
2. [Second specific action]
3. [Third specific action]

## Top 5 Headlines
1. [Most important headline from the data]
2. [Second headline]
3. [Third headline]
4. [Fourth headline]
5. [Fifth headline]';

return {
  json: {
    articles: articles,
    competitor: competitor,
    report_date: reportDate,
    openai_model: model,
    system_prompt: systemPrompt,
    user_message: userMessage,
    notion_database_id: $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.notion_database_id,
    google_sheets_id: $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.google_sheets_id,
    slack_channel: $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.slack_channel,
    email_recipient: $("Workflow Configuration").first().json.email_recipient,
  }
};
